title: Oven Cured Canadian Mackerel Wrap
description: A Jain-friendly, fermented, and tender Canadian dish featuring mackerel, shio-cure, and pandan leaf wrap, perfect for a quick and easy snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the shio cure mix, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Place the mackerel fillets in a shallow dish and coat with the shio cure mix, making sure they are fully covered.
Let the mackerel fillets cure in the refrigerator for 2 hours.
After curing, rinse the mackerel fillets under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
Place a pandan leaf on a flat surface and put a cured mackerel fillet in the center of the leaf.
Fold the pandan leaf over the mackerel fillet to form a wrap and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Place the pandan leaf wraps on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes.
Remove the pandan leaf wraps from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
